text:
jess: OK team, new idea — a tiny hybrid fitness challenge next week called 'Verticals & Intervals' 🏃‍♀️🧗‍♂️
jess: concept: 5 days (Mon-Fri). Each day do either a short stair/vertical run (10-15min intervals) OR a 10–15min climbing hangboard/core session. Points for completion. low barrier, office-friendly.
sam: love this. low barrier is key. count me in. :muscle:
marta: sounds fun. can we make a weekend makeup option? i work late thurs.
jess: yes — weekend makeup allowed, just note which day you swapped to keep leaderboard honest.
devin: logistics — where are we meeting for stair sets? office stairwell (3 flights) or nearby stadium?
jess: start at office stairwell for short bursts. if anyone wants to do a long vert session, meet at Riverside steps 6pm Tue.
leo: what exactly are the stair intervals? like 30s on 30s off?
jess: suggested: 3 rounds of 4x30s hard up, walk down recovery between reps, 2min between rounds. adapt as needed.
olivia: for climbing days — simple hangboard protocol or boulder circuit?
marta: hangboard 7s on / 3s off x 6 sets level-based OR 20min movement circuit for boulder folks.
jess: scoring: 1pt per stair session done, 1pt per hangboard/session, +1 bonus if you post a sweaty selfie or quick Strava screenshot. friendly vibes only.
sam: can poll for preferred start time? mornings or after work? @poll-bot do thing
poll-bot: POLL: "Start time preference for Vertical & Intervals" — Options: "7:00 AM (before work)", "12:30 PM (lunch)", "6:00 PM (after work)" — Vote now!
devin: voted 6pm. weekday evenings are easiest for me.
leo: 12:30 for me — lunchtime sprints.
olivia: 7am here, but can do 6pm a couple nights.
jess: updated plan: try to keep flexible. if downtown folks want a single after-work group session Tue 6pm at Riverside steps that's set. lunchtime folks do their own thing. morning crew do AM.
marta: can we do a public google sheet to track points? or just post checks in thread?
jess: i made a quick sheet: https://tinyurl.com/vert-intervals (put your name and tick days). post a quick note here when you log a day so people can cheer.
sam: sweet — added.
leo: tiny suggestion — add a column for perceived effort so people can see scaling.
jess: good call, added 'effort 1-5' column.
olivia: FYI: clinic at Crux Gym Wed 7pm if anyone wants to join for technique — discounted for Redwood.
marta: oh nice, i'll join. thanks for the heads up.
devin: also — rule: if you do both a stair and a climbing mini-session same day, only 1pt (no double dipping) so people don't feel pressured.
jess: agreed. keeping it chill.
sam: already tagging coworkers: @amy @noah — anyone else want in?
jess: tagged a few more folks. we'll check votes tomorrow and finalize kickoff Monday morning. :sparkles: :tada:
leo: one more thing — can we call the winner the 'Vertical Victor' and loser the 'Stair Anonymous'? jk.
jess: hahaha 'Vertical Victor' it is. small prize: coffee + bragging rights.
poll-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Start time preference for Vertical & Intervals" — 6:00 PM (3 votes), 12:30 PM (2 votes), 7:00 AM (1 vote).
olivia: nice, 6pm for the Riverside session then.
marta: count me in for Wed clinic + Thursday stair.
devin: cool. i'm in. see you Tue 6pm for big step party. :party_parrot:
